entries.current_effect: attestation states its own scope and unreadable paths
entries.required_work: tools/attest-clean.sh now enumerates untracked paths, records the exact commit/tree, and names each inaccessible path explicitly rather than silently scoping it away.
entries.title: Full clean-worktree attestation unavailable
entries.why_blocking: Git cannot stat tracked paths under .kin/** and evidence/**, so untracked or modified material there cannot be excluded.

entries.required_work: Nodes now carry an origin; a selftest-marked node is instrument-only and can never resolve the product channel.
entries.title: V-10 reported product PASS with no product
entries.why_blocking: Two static selftest assertions resolved both channels to PASS.

entries.current_effect: a skipped parameter keeps its function NOT_RUN
entries.required_work: Census now folds every collected parameter instance, keeping the worst outcome, and never discards an instance.
entries.title: Parameterised nodes collapsed into one census record
entries.why_blocking: f[codex] skipped and f[claude] passing folded to one key; the later record overwrote the earlier.

entries.required_work: Freeze separate raw positive and negative fixtures per obligation, drive them through shipping surfaces, and bind each result to independently captured raw evidence rather than a synthesised payload.
entries.title: Controls and mutations are circular synthetic artifacts
entries.why_blocking: conforming(), violating(), the blinded checker and the judge all derive from one clause object, so the 401-row ledger cannot establish semantic sensitivity to product behaviour.

entries.required_work: Every catalog node must emit a content-addressed evidence record for its exact OID at runtime; rows with no exact consumption must be rejected.
entries.title: Obligations lack executable checker coupling
entries.why_blocking: 66 of 92 obligations are named by a test that never calls their checker, so a weak test satisfies the census without consuming its row.

entries.required_work: Per-test analysis of every product-derived branch, rejecting collection fallbacks, optional assertion guards and unproved loop non-emptiness.
entries.title: Static green-path audit missed the patterns it forbids
entries.why_blocking: The linter checked only 0/""/False defaults and accepted a module if one total-quantifier name appeared anywhere; 24 collection defaults, 17 optional loops and 41 guarded assertion blocks remain.

entries.required_work: Apply source, fixture, config, filesystem, authority or fault mutations before product execution and independently witness the mutated state.
entries.title: Planters rewrite the result after execution
entries.why_blocking: The interposer runs the real product first and then edits stdout and exit status, mutating observation rather than causal behaviour.

entries.current_effect: a partial or infrastructure failure is no longer a kill
entries.required_work: The runner now parses per-node call-phase reports, requires every named node to fail in its expected channel, and classifies collection, setup and environment failure as INVALID_HARNESS.
entries.title: Mutation runner counts infrastructure failure as a kill
entries.why_blocking: Any nonzero pytest status marked the whole mutation KILLED, and the interposer's own configuration was dropped by the driver's env scrub.

entries.required_work: One isolated run per detector mutation, requiring the exact positive control to escape and the affected gate's instrument channel to become INVALID_HARNESS.
entries.title: Detector mutations never demonstrate gate invalidation
entries.why_blocking: One unit selftest confirms local blindness; no runner activates a mutation, executes its gate and requires INVALID_HARNESS.

entries.required_work: Type every prerequisite by origin so fixture, gold, environment, rights and collection failures raise HarnessInvalid.
entries.title: Assertion classification conflates instrument and product
entries.why_blocking: Every non-selftest AssertionError becomes PRODUCT_FAILURE, including assertions about Tester fixture counts and absent prerequisites.

entries.required_work: Enumerate all 64 exact cells with held expected pre/post native source, observation and fact/Unknown state, and a cell-specific mutation driven in the adapter's actual native format.
entries.title: V-1 lifecycle matrix is neither exact nor natively executed
entries.why_blocking: The ratified table sums to 64 cells; the catalog requires 61. Transitions write generic JSON outside the adapter's native source and all cells share one generic receipt mutation.

entries.required_work: Add the frozen calibration corpus, join opaque IDs to Tester gold, compute metrics in the harness from raw predictions, and witness every named transition before killing it.
entries.title: V-2 lacks calibration, gold-derived metrics and real sagas
entries.why_blocking: The calibration manifest is absent yet a refusal passes; metrics are product-reported; mixed-message lookups use pre-opaque IDs; crash seams are sleep-duration labels with a hardcoded recovery flag.

entries.required_work: Build the complete surface × encoding × family matrix, place native bytes on each actual surface, and require exact detector/location receipts.
entries.title: V-3 coverage is not total over surfaces and encodings
entries.why_blocking: Family coverage checks anchor names; qualification labels in-memory payloads with surface names without planting through them; the lifecycle stage list is reported rather than executed.

entries.required_work: Start and populate Company, configure the external root outside the worktree, install a repository certificate, publish registry keys and scopes, then ingest.
entries.title: Signed worlds lack the ratified external trust prerequisites
entries.why_blocking: SignedWorld writes a worktree hint and local signers with no external Company root, repository certificate or signed AuthorityRegistry, so a conforming product should refuse the intended positive fixtures.

entries.required_work: Construct and digest every pre/post state, all four relations, the 10x corpus, the revocation graph, the replay and a concurrent lock witness.
entries.title: V-4 substitutes labels for transitions, scale, replay and locking
entries.why_blocking: Rebuild/restart mark themselves changed; conflict plants no authorized resolution; three of four manifest relations; no 10x corpus, no 10,000-event revocation graph, no replay, no lock witness.

entries.required_work: Register the separate process through the live AuthorityRegistry and require a product-originated delivery receipt and invocation digest.
entries.title: V-6 has no registered live authority round trip
entries.why_blocking: The fixture never registers the helper key, scope or channel; the test invokes the helper directly, so the product never delivers a question through a registered channel.

entries.required_work: Populate Company through its admission API, install the certificate, retain historical versions and trigger real expiry and revocation.
entries.title: V-8's live service holds no fact history, cache or revocation
entries.why_blocking: Company starts but no referenced fact version is inserted, the certificate is not installed, and cache rows hardcode state_constructed.

entries.required_work: Exercise the host's real approval and install flow, invoke Codex and Claude themselves, enforce 250 ms, build the 10,000-event ceiling and a real submodule.
entries.title: V-9 performs no approved install or native host invocation
entries.why_blocking: Setup tests only dry-run and refusal; envelopes are synthetic; the invocation assertion is conditional; the 250 ms bound is asserted as 5 s; fsck uses eight events; no submodule is created.

entries.required_work: Drive a real blinded operator, time and score all 20 decisions, send distinct per-window arrivals and compute adequacy in the harness.
entries.title: V-9 permits zero operator work and trusts reported adequacy
entries.why_blocking: The blinded file is never driven; absence of a result passes; adequacy sends the same file five times and trusts product-reported slots.

entries.current_effect: semantic identity no longer reaches the product on any inspected channel
entries.required_work: The policy now inspects argv, cwd, stdin, extra_env and committed paths, and the three named leaks use opaque harness-mapped identifiers.
entries.title: Control inspection incomplete; case identity leaks
entries.why_blocking: The policy read only literal env= keys, missing argv, cwd, stdin, extra_env and committed history; the V-4 scenario, V-8 digest case and V-9 start state crossed those channels.

entries.required_work: Deterministic generation, a digest binding every byte and the selection protocol are now in place. A named human rightsholder grant remains outstanding and cannot be authored by the Tester.
entries.title: Auxiliary rights, provenance and freeze unresolved
entries.why_blocking: A Tester assertion of authorship cannot independently prove authority to grant CC0; the digest omits rights and manifest bytes; generated components had no derivation recipe.

entries.current_effect: a missing timeout plugin stops the run
entries.required_work: The suite now refuses to start when a declared plugin is missing unless an explicitly recorded untimed run is requested.
entries.title: Reviewer environment did not enforce pytest timeouts
entries.why_blocking: pytest_timeout was unavailable and the strict run still exited zero.
